name: Plinth
shortDescription: A UK charity-sector platform for volunteer profiles, matching, rotas, DBS tracking, communications and impact reporting, with wider case-management and community-service modules.
company: Time To Spare Ltd (trading as Plinth)
suitableContexts: Church charities, food banks and community projects coordinating volunteers across several activities
Church-linked organisations needing volunteer recruitment, matching, DBS-status tracking and impact reporting
Networks coordinating volunteers across multiple partner organisations

pricing.summary: Plinth publishes tailored pricing based on organisation size and needs rather than a standard price card. Request a written quote covering enabled modules, active volunteer or organisation limits, implementation, training, AI features, data migration, support, renewal and exit terms.

tiers.label: Tailored subscription
tiers.detail: Supplier states that pricing is tailored to an organisation's size and needs.

gdprInformation: Plinth's public privacy policy says data is processed in the UK and EU, encrypted in transit and at rest, and deleted from servers within 30 days after cancellation; it also identifies a sub-processor listing. Supplier material says a DPA is available and AI features process within European infrastructure, but that material is not a substitute for reviewing the live contract, sub-processor list, retention configuration, access roles, audit trail, export and AI-data terms for the church's intended use.
coreFeatures: Volunteer profiles with skills, interests, availability and compliance status
DBS status tracking and expiry alerts
Wider case-management, surveys and room-booking modules according to supplier
integrations: Supplier describes wider modules in one platform; confirm any external accounting, payment, identity, DBS or communication integrations needed for the church
importExport: Supplier public material describes data portability rights; confirm current export formats, full-record scope, attachments, audit history, timing and assistance in writing
support: Supplier invites organisations to contact its team or book a demo in relevant current product guidance
Support contact is published at support@plinth.org.uk

uk-operator.value: Plinth's current material identifies Time To Spare Ltd trading as Plinth at a London address. Companies House identifies Time To Spare Ltd, company 11530023.

volunteer-workflow.value: Supplier describes volunteer profiles, DBS tracking, geographic matching, shortlisting, multi-organisation coordination, rota scheduling, communications and impact reporting.

faith-charity-relevance.value: Supplier's faith-based-charity guidance describes Plinth as combining case management, room bookings, volunteering and impact reporting for UK charities.

data-handling.value: Supplier's privacy policy describes UK and EU processing, encryption in transit and at rest, deletion times after cancellation, recovery-log retention and a sub-processor listing.

editorial.assessment: Plinth is a broad UK charity-sector platform rather than church-management software. Its volunteer module is potentially relevant to church charities and sizeable community projects because it joins recruitment, matching, rota coordination, DBS-status tracking, communications and reporting. Its breadth and data sensitivity mean a church should treat it as a formal procurement exercise, especially where case-management, sensitive volunteer information or supplier AI features are in scope.
bestFor: Church-run charities and community services with a substantial volunteer programme
Networks or umbrella bodies coordinating volunteers across multiple organisations
Teams needing structured volunteer records, matching, reporting and compliance-status reminders rather than a simple Sunday rota
strengths: Identified UK operator and current UK charity-sector focus
Volunteer recruitment, profiles, matching, rotas and reporting in one platform
Public privacy information includes processing region, encryption and cancellation-deletion statement
limitations: No public standard pricing or module-by-module cost
Do not interpret DBS-status tracking as proof that a church's safeguarding process is sufficient
Broader case-management and AI features require careful lawful-basis, access, retention and data-processing review
Confirm integrations, exports, service levels and user roles against the specific module set purchased

procurementVerdict.problem: Running a large, evidence-rich volunteer programme across charity, community and partner-organisation activities
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity-sector platform that combines volunteer management with matching, reporting and wider community-service workflows
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Map one real volunteer journey from application through matching, DBS-status administration, rota, communication and exit; request a current module-level quote, DPA, sub-processor list, AI terms and representative export before importing people or case data
